metadata.description: credless: signed-in, multi-user Playwright end-to-end tests a coding agent runs without the long-lived credential. One plugin: the e2e-testing skill and the deny-secrets hook.
metadata.note: Add this marketplace at a release tag, never at main: the plugin's hook runs before every Bash call of your sessions, so install what you reviewed. Pin the tag when adding the marketplace (the repository URL followed by #v<version>) and update on purpose.

plugins.name: credless
plugins.description: The e2e-testing skill (expected behaviour first, case list, cheapest layer, the framework, running, judging, agents) and a PreToolUse hook that refuses commands which would read the kit's staging dir, .env files, a process environment or a secret manager. A backstop, not a boundary.
